intent: Match binocular observation to original pictured actions; retain marked-path and conditional non-disturbance requirements; distinguish one visit’s observations from annual population claims and plan comparable recorded observations.

workshop.title: 看动作，改方案，审结论
workshop.instruction: 选出观鸟动作，再改好两项行动；把一次所见与全年结论分开，安排可比较的复查。

items.label: 先找导游要求怎样看鸟
items.prompt: How should students watch the birds?
items.reason: Watch from a distance明确保留距离，with the binoculars给观察工具。靠近拍照只是学生提问，不是导游同意；禁止投喂不能读成先喂再看。
items.hint: 找清要求、禁止与推断范围：看见得少，不等于全年数量已下降。
items.material:
Guide: Please keep to the marked path while we watch the birds. Do not offer them food. Watch from a distance with the binoculars.
Student: Can we move closer for a photo?
Guide: Not if it disturbs them. A good observation does not require making an animal change its behaviour.

items.answer: Stay on the marked path; do not move closer if that disturbs the birds.
items.reason: keep to the marked path给活动位置；Not if it disturbs them限制靠近拍照。好的观察不以迫使动物改变行为为条件。不能把有条件的拒绝改成“任何情况下都禁止拍照”。

items.label: 找出一次观察不能证明全年趋势的原因
items.prompt: Why is one visit not enough for the yearly claim?
items.answer: Time, weather and observation method can affect what is seen.
items.reason: 老师没有否认这次看见较少昆虫，也没有说昆虫永远不能计数。Time、weather与method会影响看见什么，因此不能凭一次访问证明全年数量更少。
items.hint: 找清要求、禁止与推断范围：看见得少，不等于全年数量已下降。
items.material:
Mei: We saw fewer insects in the garden this afternoon. Does that prove there are fewer this year?
Teacher: Not from one visit. Time, weather and observation method can affect what you see.
Mei: We should repeat the observation in comparable conditions.
Teacher: Yes, and record those conditions.

Repeat the observation in ____ conditions.
